title: runIT published enums and #define groups
description: Output of templates/generate_enums.py: every //#ref-enum enum and //#ref-defines group of the firmware headers. Generated; do not edit.

enums.description: Published groups by C name (enum typedef name, or the group name of //#ref-defines).

symbols.description: Member name -> name of the one group that holds it.

alias.description: The title a user sees (@alias of the marker).

prefix.description: Only for kind 'defines': the prefix every #define of the group starts with.

source_file.description: Header the group is declared in, relative to the repository root.

alias.description: The name a user sees (@alias); never derived from the C identifier.

wire_size.description: Bytes of one element on the wire (@wire-size).

mem_size.description: Bytes of one element in the board's memory (@mem-size).
